title: J6d Shadow Crossroads
description: v2.8 plan 12 J6d synthetic fixture: four typed qualities (two choice, a rating, a stated count) the judge answers, one residual quality the extractor answers. The exits need a storm that never comes, so the read stays at the crossroads.

qualities.rubric: Which road has the party chosen at the crossroads?
How much does the smith trust the party, from 0 (wary) to 3 (trusting)?
Does the party hold the smith's map?
How many coins has the party paid the smith?
What is the weather at the crossroads?

checkpoints.name: The Crossroads
checkpoints.objective: Choose a road with the smith's help.
